GEOGRAPHY, the most important instruction: the LEFT 44% of the frame, from the top edge to the bottom edge, is one continuous, evenly dark, deep navy-black matte plaster studio wall with fine visible texture: no light falls on it, no glow, no bokeh, no ribbon and no objects; it is calm from edge to edge. Everything lit lives in the RIGHT 54% of the frame, between 14% and 84% of the frame height. The LOWEST 16% of the frame is a near-black matte stage riser right in front of the lens, crossing the whole width, completely out of focus, non-reflective, outside every light. THE MOMENT: a creative squad of EXACTLY FOUR Latin American people in their late twenties to early forties, two women and two men standing close together, shoulders overlapping, so the group stays compact with varied hair, all wearing the Efeonce hoodie exactly as in its reference, stand in ONE single line shoulder to shoulder across the frame, framed from the waist up, the TOP of ALL FOUR heads at about 29% of the frame height, all four heads in the same band between 29% and 47%, the riser cutting them at the waist; they all look straight into the lens with calm, confident expressions. Running in front of their chests from left to right, a long, flowing RIBBON of warm orange (#FF6500) light carries dozens of small glowing deliverables of different formats (stories, square posts, banners, video frames), all different yet sharing one brand look. The woman second from the right has lifted ONE piece off the ribbon and holds it up just in front of her chin, never above her head, fully visible arm, checking it closely: that piece is the brightest element and lights her face. The ribbon is the only key light on the squad; NO fill light. A cool azure (#0375DB) rim light from behind outlines their hair and shoulders. Thin haze catches the ribbon, only in the RIGHT half of the frame. Nobody looks at anybody else. The pieces are rounded rectangles: no circles, no dots, no spheres, no rings. Camera about five meters away at chest height, 85mm, realistic adult proportions, nothing foreshortened. Fine dust, real sensor grain, genuine depth of field. Rich contrast, deep navy blacks. No readable text, no letters, no logos of any other brand. CAMERA FAR AWAY: the four people are SMALL in the frame, each about one third of the frame height, standing in the right part of the space. HORIZONTAL LIMIT (essential, checked): every person, creature, light trail, projected shape, screen and prop sits entirely to the RIGHT of the vertical line at 56% of the frame width; the LEFT half of the frame shows only the dark calm surface, with nothing in it.
